io.name: clk
io.description: Clock input; state updates on posedge.

io.name: q
io.description: Combinational output derived from state and inputs.

functional_summary.overview: Single flip-flop sequential circuit. On each posedge of clk, state updates to the next-state function of (state, a, b). Output q is a combinational function of (state, a, b).
rules: q = state XOR a  [combinational; matches observed q values]
state updates only on posedge clk; q reflects current state and inputs combinationally.
